accounting.cost_prices: predeclared abstract work prices; not measured currency, energy or FLOPs
accounting.durability: replay, alternatives, failed runs and raw sources separate from minimum serving bytes
accounting.event_memory_count: one shared full-rank EventMemory for its two field views, reused from transfer; no repeated training hidden
accounting.minimum_deployment: actual weights plus addresses, type/codec/model bindings, router, layout and view maps
accounting.runtime: Python/NumPy/ONNX/runtime code are common infrastructure, not hidden learned state; serialized-system totals are not peak RSS
accounting.shared_encoder_count: one per deployed system; all fitting/inference calls and caches reported

boundaries: V1/V2/V3 failed gates and evidence remain byte unchanged.
All four science domains are now previously seen; only the retail-held source partition and independently authored language are new for v4.
The language author did not execute a router on the held file; the routing owner did not read its contents before freeze.
The source values are written before hidden reads; this is not unseen-fact prediction.
UTF8 bytes are read from trained factors without an answer-class dictionary; high rank may cost more than strong ordinary compression.
Learned affine coefficients use supplied function families and tensor types; multiplication/calendar operations and type catalogs are supplied.
No full production integration, universal type invention, universal compression or complete weight unlearning is claimed.
Every empirical blocker remains open unless its predeclared actual gate passes; sealed failure is not a scientific success.
Typed maintenance is a separate versioned-owner experiment; the joint language study reuses an immutable transfer artifact and does not claim live production integration.

joint.event_view_scope: The quantity or GBP unit price of the first selected written event by source_row in each recorded month; not a population monthly sales statistic.
joint.numeric_capacity_scope: Rank12 is a larger predeclared parameter capacity, not a same-budget replacement for V3 rank4. Rank4 distortion is retained as control.
joint.routing_scope: Six explicitly declared request types. Unsupported windows/statistics remain policy refusals even when a particular numerical answer happens to equal a supported operation.
joint.strong_baseline: Same learned router with supplied exact typed planner and strong exact source codec; oracle routing is a separate diagnostic.

not_tested_claims: complete erasure of withdrawn values from all historical artifacts
production admission of new v4 event/procedure types

statistics.source_fitting: Factor SVD and event writes deterministic; query addresses and affine demonstrations vary by seed.
statistics.unit: seed conditional on fixed workload. The 216 authored language templates are reused across domains/anchors/seeds and are not 6480 independent language observations.

structure.scope: New changing numeric flows require >=5% normalized quality gain and net benefit versus both efficient natural and matched-work fixed controls. Static excess MSE <= 0.01 * max(best_fixed_MSE, 1) and natural priced-loss ratio <= 1.10 form a separate bounded-regret diagnostic, not strict zero-cost advantage or a uniform 1% relative error bound. V3 gates and all-flow strict diagnostics remain unchanged.
